# Berth handover

Draft the handover note for the watch that is ending.

1. Read the berth roster for the current watch.
2. List every vessel that arrived, departed, or shifted berth.
3. Note each berth left occupied and the expected departure time.

Write the note as a table of berth, vessel, and expected departure. Say
which watch the note covers.
